ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint'), !ISNEW(), OR( ISCHANGED( IDR_Avoidable_Escalation__c ), ISCHANGED( IDR_Avoidable_Escalation_Reason__c )), AND(AND(TEXT(Status)!='Escalated', TEXT(Status)!='Provisionally Closed', TEXT(Status)!='Closed'), !OR(PRIORVALUE(Status)='Escalated', PRIORVALUE(Status)='Provisionally Closed', PRIORVALUE(Status)='Closed')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Avoidable Escalation' and 'Avoidable Escalation Reason' can only be updated on Escalated, Closed or Provisionally Closed cases.
